title: Cross-Architecture Probe Transfer: Does a Jailbreak Detector Trained on LLaMA Transfer to Mistral?

original_idea.quick_reasoning: Clearly addresses an AI Safety problem with a reasonably scoped approach.

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Cross-architecture transferability determines whether activation probes are practical for multi-model deployments. If transfer works, it is a major efficiency gain. If not, it motivates architecture-agnostic methods. Clear practical impact.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Training a probe on one model and evaluating on others is conceptually simple. However, aligning layers by relative depth across different architectures and handling different hidden dimensions requires moderate familiarity with model internals.

narrow_scope.reasoning: One training model, 3 evaluation models. But loading 4 different models, extracting activations from each, and handling dimension/layer alignment adds up. Could fit in 30 hours with careful scoping but is tight.
